afterkey: Three writes across two keys reduce to two latest rows. The blue terminal row carries a deletion.
tailstate: A reader cursor separates acknowledged rows from an ordered blue page. Further rows remain available.
sincekit: A single array of changed keys serves three readers. Each reader takes a different prefix.
guardshift: Two conditions change state in opposite directions after the same update batch.
kthwake: A moving window contains three event ticks. The blue boundary marks the next expiration while no new events arrive.
pulsefold: One heartbeat starts three deadline intervals. Blue endpoints show when each reader marks it stale.
edgechime: A point moves through two overlapping rectangular zones. Blue crossings mark changes in membership.
